description: Elevated core body temperature above 38.5°C
synonyms: pyrexia, hot body, chills, temperature
follow_up_questions: Is the fever intermittent or continuous? Any rigors or shivering? Has the patient taken antimalarials?

description: Intense, persistent head pain
synonyms: head pain, migraine, throbbing head
follow_up_questions: Is it the worst headache of the patient’s life? Sudden or gradual onset? Any visual changes or vomiting?

description: Painful resistance to passive neck flexion
synonyms: stiff neck, cannot bend neck, nuchal rigidity
follow_up_questions: Can the patient touch chin to chest? Any sensitivity to light? Any rash?

description: Reduced alertness, disorientation or unresponsiveness
related_conditions: Cerebral malaria, Meningitis, Hypoglycaemia, Sepsis, Stroke
synonyms: confused, drowsy, unconscious, not responding, coma, collapsed
follow_up_questions: Does the patient respond to voice or pain? Any history of diabetes? Any recent seizures or head injury?

description: Difficulty breathing or breathlessness at rest or on exertion
synonyms: breathless, cannot breathe, difficulty breathing, dyspnea, dyspnoea
follow_up_questions: Does it occur at rest or only on exertion? Any wheeze? Can the patient speak in full sentences?

description: Cough lasting more than one week
synonyms: coughing, chesty cough, dry cough
follow_up_questions: Is it productive? Any blood in the sputum? Longer than 2 weeks? Any TB contact?

description: Pressure, tightness or pain in the chest
related_conditions: Acute coronary syndrome, Pneumonia, Pulmonary embolism, Pericarditis
synonyms: chest tightness, chest pressure, heart pain
follow_up_questions: Does it spread to the arm, jaw or back? Worse on breathing in? Any sweating or nausea with it?

description: Intense pain anywhere in the abdomen
related_conditions: Appendicitis, Typhoid perforation, Ectopic pregnancy, Intestinal obstruction
synonyms: stomach pain, belly pain, tummy ache, abdominal cramps
follow_up_questions: Where exactly is the pain? Is the abdomen rigid or tender? Last menstrual period? Passing stool and gas?

description: Repeated vomiting over several hours
synonyms: throwing up, vomit, emesis, being sick
follow_up_questions: How many times today? Any blood or bile? Can the patient keep fluids down?

description: Three or more loose or watery stools in 24 hours
synonyms: loose stools, watery stool, running stomach, purging
follow_up_questions: How many stools today? Any blood or mucus? Is the patient passing urine normally? Rice-water appearance?

description: Marked loss of energy and reduced ability to perform usual activities
synonyms: tiredness, body weakness, malaise, lethargy
follow_up_questions: How many days has it lasted? Any weight loss? Is the patient eating normally?

description: Reduced desire to eat over several days
synonyms: anorexia, not eating, poor feeding
follow_up_questions: How long has the patient eaten less than usual? Any nausea with it?

description: Drenching sweats, especially at night
synonyms: sweating at night, drenching sweat
follow_up_questions: Do the sweats soak the bedding? Any cough longer than 2 weeks? Any weight loss?

description: Episodes of uncontrolled shaking or loss of consciousness
related_conditions: Cerebral malaria, Epilepsy, Febrile convulsion, Eclampsia
synonyms: fits, convulsing, shaking, epilepsy
follow_up_questions: How long did the fit last? Is it the first episode? Was there fever before it? Is the patient pregnant?

description: Light-headedness or brief loss of consciousness
synonyms: faint, light-headed, syncope, vertigo, collapsed
follow_up_questions: Did the patient fully lose consciousness? Does it happen on standing? Any palpitations?

symptom_name: Weakness on One Side of Body
description: Sudden unilateral limb or facial weakness
synonyms: hemiparesis, face drooping, cannot move arm, slurred speech
follow_up_questions: When exactly did it start? Any facial droop or speech difficulty? Known hypertension?

description: Blood in sputum (haemoptysis)
synonyms: haemoptysis, hemoptysis, blood in sputum, blood when coughing
follow_up_questions: How much blood — streaks or cupfuls? Any weight loss or night sweats?

description: High-pitched whistling sound on breathing out
synonyms: whistling chest, tight chest, noisy breathing
follow_up_questions: Known asthma? Any inhaler used today? Any recent exposure to smoke or dust?

description: Pain or scratchiness in the throat
synonyms: throat pain, painful swallowing
follow_up_questions: Difficulty swallowing? Any white patches on the tonsils? Any fever?

description: Awareness of fast, irregular or pounding heartbeat
synonyms: racing heart, heart pounding, irregular heartbeat
follow_up_questions: Is the beat regular or irregular? Any dizziness or chest pain with it? Caffeine or stimulant use?

description: Bilateral pitting oedema of the lower limbs
related_conditions: Heart failure, Kidney disease, Pre-eclampsia, Liver disease
synonyms: oedema, edema, swollen feet, puffy legs
follow_up_questions: Both legs or one? Any breathlessness lying flat? Is the patient pregnant?

description: Visible fresh or dark blood in faeces
synonyms: bloody stool, melaena, melena, black stool
follow_up_questions: Bright red or black and tarry? Any abdominal pain? Any NSAID use?

description: Yellow discolouration of sclera or skin
related_conditions: Hepatitis, Severe malaria, Sickle cell crisis, Biliary obstruction
synonyms: jaundice, yellow eyes, yellow skin
follow_up_questions: Dark urine or pale stools? Any itching? Any alcohol or herbal medicine use?

description: Sunken eyes, dry mouth, reduced skin turgor or reduced urine output
synonyms: dehydrated, sunken eyes, dry mouth, not passing urine
follow_up_questions: When did the patient last pass urine? Is the patient drinking? Is the child lethargic?

description: Pain, warmth or swelling in one or more joints
related_conditions: Sickle cell crisis, Septic arthritis, Rheumatoid arthritis, Gout
synonyms: arthralgia, painful joints, swollen knee
follow_up_questions: One joint or many? Any fever? Known sickle cell disease?

description: Severe deep bone pain in a known sickle cell patient
synonyms: crisis, bone pain, sickle cell pain
follow_up_questions: Where is the pain? Any chest pain or breathlessness (acute chest syndrome)? Fluid intake today?

description: Recent physical injury, fall, road traffic accident or assault
synonyms: accident, fall, wound, fracture, RTA
follow_up_questions: How did it happen? Any loss of consciousness? Any bleeding that will not stop? Can the patient bear weight?

description: New rash anywhere on the body
related_conditions: Measles, Chickenpox, Drug reaction, Meningococcal sepsis
synonyms: spots, skin eruption, hives, itchy skin
follow_up_questions: Does the rash fade when pressed with a glass? Any fever? Any new medicines? Any contact with measles?

description: Open wound, boil or collection of pus
synonyms: boil, pus, sore, ulcer, cut
follow_up_questions: How old is the wound? Any spreading redness? Tetanus vaccination up to date?

description: Burning or pain when passing urine
synonyms: dysuria, burning urine, frequent urination
follow_up_questions: Any blood in the urine? Any flank pain or fever? Any discharge?

description: Any bleeding per vaginam in a pregnant woman
related_conditions: Miscarriage, Ectopic pregnancy, Placenta praevia, Abruption
synonyms: bleeding pregnant, spotting, antepartum haemorrhage
follow_up_questions: How many weeks pregnant? How heavy is the bleeding? Any abdominal pain? Any dizziness?

description: Regular painful uterine contractions
synonyms: contractions, in labour, waters broken
follow_up_questions: How many weeks pregnant? How far apart are the contractions? Have the waters broken? Is the baby moving?

description: Pain in the ear or fluid draining from the ear canal
synonyms: earache, ear discharge, pus from ear
follow_up_questions: One ear or both? Any fever? Any hearing loss?
